title: Allowing Non-Administrator Users Access to Zscaler Client Connector Log Files

blocks.text: This feature enables Zscaler Admin Console administrators to grant Zscaler Client Connector log file access to users who don’t have administrator privileges. This allows non-administrator users to send specific log files to admins instead of having to send the entire log folder in a ZIP file, making the troubleshooting process more efficient.
To allow non-admin users access to the Zscaler program data folder to access log files:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > User Privacy.
Select Allow access to Client Connector logs folder for non administrators.
